summary: Fixed white screen crash when editing players in Team Admin tab. The issue was caused by sportConfig.positions being an array of objects {id, name, abbrev} but the code was treating them as strings. Also verified Stats tab and Player Stats subtab work correctly after backend fix.

fixed_bugs.issue: Edit Player modal crashed with 'Objects are not valid as a React child' error when position field was an object {id, name, abbrev}
fixed_bugs.fix: Updated position select to use pos.id as key and pos.name as value/display text. Also added defensive handling for position display in player list.

critical_code_review_comments: React key warning: 'Encountered two children with the same key' - may indicate duplicate player IDs in the data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fixed the Edit Player modal crash in TeamAdminTab.js. The issue was that sportConfig.positions returns objects {id, name, abbrev} but the code was using them directly as strings in the select options. Fixed by using pos.id as key and pos.name as value. Also added defensive handling for displaying position in player list rows.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: sportConfig.positions in sportsConfig.js returns an array of objects like {id: 'attack', name: 'Attack', abbrev: 'A'}, but TeamAdminTab.js was using these objects directly as React children in the select options (key={pos}, value={pos}, {pos}), causing React to throw 'Objects are not valid as a React child' error.
reproduction_steps: 4. Click Edit icon on any player
rca_of_the_issue.fix_applied: Changed select options from key={pos} value={pos}>{pos} to key={pos.id} value={pos.name}>{pos.name}. Also added defensive handling for position display: typeof player.position === 'object' ? player.position?.name : player.position
